title: FACED - Finer-grained Affective Computing EEG Dataset
description: FACED is a scalp EEG dataset from 123 healthy participants who watched 28 emotion-eliciting video clips targeting nine emotion categories: four negative, four positive, and neutral. Participants gave self-reported ratings on 12 dimensions, including discrete emotions, valence, arousal, liking and familiarity. The dataset supports cross-subject affective computing research and the development of EEG-based emotion recognition algorithms. This BIDS version, converted by Pierre Guetschel, adds stimulus metadata and event annotations.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 32 channels placed according to the 10-20 system with a Biosemi system, sampled at 1000 Hz (92 subjects) or 250 Hz (31 subjects). Participants sat 60 cm from a 22-inch monitor. Each trial had a 5 s fixation cross, a video clip (typically 30-60 s; individual clips range from about 34 to 129 s), and a 12-item emotion rating. Blocks of clips were separated by arithmetic problems to reduce carryover effects. Raw BDF files were converted to BIDS with MNE-BIDS, and events were parsed from evt.bdf annotations.
